CustomField.description: Calculates the Monthly Recurring Revenue for the Quote Line Item by multiplying the Quantity by the Net Unit Price. Rounded to whole dollars except for SKUs 001-CYBR-SVC-SAPX-USER-002 and 001-INFR-SVC-MONI-DEVC-001, which retain cents.
CustomField.formula: IF( PricingTermCount > 0, IF( OR( Product2.StockKeepingUnit = "001-CYBR-SVC-SAPX-USER-002", Product2.StockKeepingUnit = "001-INFR-SVC-MONI-DEVC-001" ), NetUnitPrice * Quantity, ROUND( NetUnitPrice * Quantity, 0 ) ), 0)
CustomField.label: MRR
